verdict.rationale: Pigment's Analyst Agent is described as one that "continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters," and variance analysis can flag the reasons behind gaps against budget. Together these suggest some first-party proactive surfacing of metric movements against plan, but nothing explicitly says the user is pushed an alert without asking. The documented email/Slack notifications are triggered by a user tagging a colleague in a comment, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit threshold- or variance-triggered alerts to the user, deadline or reporting-calendar reminders, documented alert delivery channels and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
